lines.text: The team sailed from Troas to Samothrace, then Neapolis, and went on to the Roman colony of Philippi.
Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira, was baptized with her household and urged the team to stay at her house.
Paul commanded the spirit in the name of King David to leave the slave girl, and her owners dragged Paul and Silas before the authorities.
After being beaten, Paul and Silas were put in the inner cell, and at midnight an earthquake shook the prison while they sang hymns to God.
Paul said they were Roman soldiers, and the alarmed magistrates came to appease them, so after leaving prison they went to Lydia's house.
